charter_sources.cwi_care: agents/cwi-care/CHARTER.md — Response-time standards (measured); Metric; Kill rule; lane conversion kill rule (2026-10-01, needs Lansky's word)
charter_sources.cwi_guide: agents/cwi-guide/CHARTER.md — no response-time targets in charter; Guide targets below are new, published 2026-10-01, grounded in Care's measured standards

compliance_log.history: Measurement began 2026-09-23 under v1.2 targets; zero tickets were ever filed; log never backfilled. v2.0 targets take effect 2026-10-01; measurement against v2.0 begins that day.

definitions.acknowledge: First confirmation a real agent received the issue, with content (an auto-receipt alone does not count).
definitions.clock: Starts at the received timestamp (stored UTC, displayed US/Eastern). Calendar hours — not business days. v1.2's business-day framing is retired; the charters measure in calendar hours.
definitions.escalation: Handoff with evidence to ENG-REL (bugs), CWI_Affairs (economy disputes), or KingCode (Black's name, wallet, credentials, security).
definitions.exclusions: Time awaiting required info from the user is logged as 'awaiting user' and excluded. Owner-only topics (spending, wallet signing, identity, paid accounts) queue to Black personally; queue time is shown, not hidden.
definitions.resolution: Verified resolution confirmed with the user — an issue is closed by verified resolution, not by replying.
definitions.substantive_response: An answer, a verified workaround, or a named next step with an owner.
definitions.ticket: Any user problem or request reaching CWI_Care/CWI_Guide through the published intake (GitHub issue support template, hp@cumulativeweb.com, or an in-product contact path). Spam and abuse are excluded and labeled as excluded.

on_breach.a11_honest_downgrade: 30 days with SLA missed on >20% of tickets → the published target is downgraded to what was actually achieved — dated, announced in the compliance log, old target kept as history. Never silent, never backfilled, never re-labeled. A downgrade proposal itself triggers the Care charter review rule.
on_breach.care_charter: Any issue unacknowledged >24h or unresolved/un-escalated >72h → same-day KingCode review. In any 7-day window with ≥4 issues, breach rate >25% → re-staff and re-brief the desk. Misses SLA two review cycles running → charter rewritten or function reabsorbed.
on_breach.guide_charter: A launch ships without Guide's docs, or docs carry an unverified claim → charter review immediately; two review cycles missed → charter rewritten or function reabsorbed.
